option_relations.rationale: Extramedullary plasmacytoma is a plasma cell neoplasm, distinct from the Natural Killer/T-cell lymphoma listed as a leaf.

Non-Hodgkin lymphoma is a broad category. While Extranodal Natural Killer/T-cell lymphoma is a type of Non-Hodgkin lymphoma, the option 'not otherwise specified' is too general and does not directly relate to the specific leaf provided.
Primary extramedullary plasmacytoma is a plasma cell neoplasm, distinct from the Natural Killer/T-cell lymphoma listed as a leaf.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is a type of B-cell lymphoma, distinct from the Natural Killer/T-cell lymphoma listed as a leaf.
